title: Guardrail with an uncertain outcome
description: Block, allow or send to review a message or LLM output that may be phishing, spam, harassment or abuse

channel.description: state header, e.g. 'Inbound email to support@shop.example'

categories.description: label and description of each category; 'none' is added

block.instructions: Should this message be blocked because it is phishing, scam, spam, harassment or hate directed at a person, or a threat, rather than ordinary legitimate communication?

criteria.true: Phishing, scam, spam, harassment, hate or threats: block it
criteria.false: Ordinary legitimate communication, including blunt criticism or venting that does not target a person

category.instructions: Which moderation category best fits this message?

harm.instructions: How harmful would it be to let this message through to its recipient?
criteria: dangerous: credential theft, financial fraud or credible threat

combine: block if block >= block_at; allow if block <= allow_at; uncertain otherwise
limitations: text only (no URL reputation or attachments)
relationship context must be in state
inbound channels may run with fail_mode open (allow + log): pass it to run_recipe; outbound stays closed
a category p_top below 0.6 is not relabelled 'unclear'; read category_p
notes: # deviation: spec 2.18/5.17: decisions are ordered allow, uncertain, block (least to most severe); categories is an array of {label, description}; the default profile is `strict` = the spec default 0.85/0.15 and the spec's strict 0.5/0.05 is `paranoid`; direction, harm, deadline_ms and fail_mode are run parameters, not inputs; a failed read gives uncertain with the error code as the reason, not 'guardrail_unavailable'
